name: Survey tile in Libra
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.4 degrees south of the ecliptic in Libra, imaged by SPHEREx 18 times in 7 visits over 49 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 34 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 33 hours starting 2026-07-13, at wavelengths from 1.12 to 4.86 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
